doc.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Lydian book publication and marriage to Juanita
title: Juanita Odjenar, his first wife
summary: He credits Juanita, later married to Jimmy Giuffre, for support, and explains the tune Odjenar.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: A lot of that is creditable to Juanita, my first wife.
She’s funny. She’s really funny, a sweet woman. Spent the last ten years now of looking after Jimmy Giuffre.
She is now married to Jimmy Giuffre.
She married Jimmy. That’s been about 15 years ago.
O-d-e-j-e-n-a-r, I think. I always wondered what that – that’s the title of a tune.
Well yes, but I always wondered – I wonder what Odjenar means?
If you want, I can call her, and she’ll fill the book with things.
